text: DataSentry: from a failed warehouse check to an auditable operator decision.
Recorded UI and repository evidence, not one continuous autonomous repair.
A clean daily snapshot does not mean the active incident queue is healthy.
The retained desktop view still shows 17 active incidents, including 10 critical incidents.
Airflow orchestrates S3 landing, ClickHouse raw data, dbt models and deterministic quality checks.
Checks create alerts. Guarded investigation reads the evidence; AI does not move or repair data.
ClickHouse and object storage retain evidence. PostgreSQL serializes transactional control state.
The optional model explains and recommends within bounded tools, budgets and audit records.
Start from a specific Alert Ref, rule, table and business date.
Discord and Streamlit share incident context through the control-plane API.
Recorded Discord Help: show incidents, choose an Alert Ref and inspect the evidence.
Help is deterministic. It does not call a model, approve, repair or close incidents.
The recorded workspace keeps reports, evidence and follow-up questions in one incident thread.
Reading a stored report does not imply a new investigation or paid provider call.
Recorded English Streamlit: the historical daily snapshot is not the independent active incident queue.
The dark desktop view retains the same facts. Mobile and two-human acceptance are not established.
Stored report RPT-85F4FEA2 records 93 duplicate records out of 2,919 rows for this incident.
The recorded Gemini narrative cites quality history, recent pipeline runs and dbt lineage evidence.
The exact upstream cause remains unconfirmed. Review source evidence before approving remediation.
Historical Gemini provenance, viewed read-only on 2026-10-15. No new call or repair.
Trace raw orders through staging to the daily mart using retained dbt metadata.
Lineage supports impact investigation; it is not proof of a downstream outage.
The repository data model separates analytical facts from transactional control state.
Approvals, revalidation and closure keep their own durable identities and audit trail.
Separate acceptance evidence: an approval decision does not start remediation.
Recorded APPROVED and REJECTED requests both retained execution_status=not_started.
A successful Airflow run can still produce a blocked business verdict.
The negative revalidation found 24 of 25 required segments. Closure stayed blocked.
A separate read-only request found 25 of 25 segments. Resolve did not repair the source.
Matching fresh PASS evidence still needs an operator reason and explicit confirmation.
Recorded resolved card: a fresh scoped check supported closure of this incident only.
No data repair, no LLM call and no claim that the whole warehouse is healthy.
To reproduce locally, follow README setup with Docker and Compose. Review local secrets first.
Keep external models disabled and provider keys blank for the initial local run.
Build and start using the documented commands, then inspect Airflow and Streamlit.
Use DAG 91 for application acceptance. This recording is media, not a new platform test.
